title: New This Week on MSFS 2024 Marketplace (PC): F27 Friendship, Learjet 35A & Fresh Liveries
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update (March 22, 2026): New MSFS 2024 Aircraft! This week's MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update for PC is packed with "must-have" releases, featuring the legendary iniBuilds Fokker F27 Friendship and the high-performance FlySimWare Learjet 35A 2024.

Whether you're looking for the best MSFS 2024 aircraft or new MSFS 2024 liveries, this weekly roundup covers the latest business jets, turboprops, and vintage rotorcraft to expand your hangar.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Microsoft / iniBuilds: Fokker F27 Friendship (classic regional turboprop vibes)
🛫 FlySimWare: Learjet-35A-2024 (fast business jet fun for modern ops)
🛫 Rara-AVIS sims: Bulldog AutoGyro (gyro goodness for low-and-slow exploring)
🛫 Rara-AVIS sims: Whittaker MW6 (another unique rotorcraft option)
🛫 Rara-AVIS sims: Robinson Redwing II & III (vintage-style flying with character)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200 Livery Pack 4 (more paint options for the 767-200)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200 Livery Pack 5 (even more variety for the 767-200)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER PW Livery Pack 4 (PW engine variant liveries)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER PW Livery Pack 5 (PW engine variant liveries)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER GE Livery Pack 4 (GE engine variant liveries)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER GE Livery Pack 5 (GE engine variant liveries)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200SF Livery Pack 4 (freighter repaint pack)
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200SF Livery Pack 5 (freighter repaint pack)
🎨 Inibuilds: A300-600R Cargo Livery Pack (fresh cargo looks for the A300-600R)
🎨 Inibuilds: A300600R Passenger livery pack (new passenger variants to rotate in)
🎨 JED Studio: JEDS GotFriends DracoX liveries (extra style for the DracoX)
🎨 Stol Addicts: Stol Addicts HJET Livery pack high (HJET repaint pack)

🧭 Other items added this week (PC)
The following other items were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🧭 RMStudios: Garmin G5+AERA (handy avionics option for GA flying)
🧭 Thrustmaster: TM TCA Airbus 4 engines (hardware/profile related add-on)
🧭 Thrustmaster: TM Devices profiles (more controller profile support)

If you enjoyed the update, drop a like, subscribe for weekly MSFS Marketplace videos, and let me know in the comments which one you’re picking up — team F27, team Learjet, or team gyro/vintage this week? 😎

✈️ See you in the skies!
